text: This episode covers distributed systems fundamentals. We explain consensus, replication, and partition tolerance. Leaders coordinate writes while followers serve reads. Clock skew complicates ordering without synchronized time. Idempotent handlers make retries safe under at-least-once delivery. This episode covers distributed systems fundamentals.
